patterns.description: Strong product-market fit correlates with low CAC/LTV ratio below 0.2 and NPS above 58
patterns.evidence: Both DataFlow (CAC/LTV 0.167, NPS 62) and MediLink (CAC/LTV 0.135, NPS 58) show strong unit economics aligned with positive customer feedback
patterns.recommendation: Ventures with proven CAC/LTV <0.2 are candidates for growth acceleration - consider scaling sales and marketing investment

patterns.description: Ventures in growth stage with accelerating team velocity show 6-8 point health score improvement
patterns.evidence: DataFlow improved from 78 to 84 health score with team velocity accelerating and hiring ahead of plan
patterns.recommendation: Monitor team dynamics carefully - momentum matters; support teams showing acceleration with resources and mentorship

outliers.name: TruckRoute Pro
outliers.description: Week 32 venture showing stagnation with CAC/LTV ratio of 0.778 (2.5x healthier ventures), declining team velocity, and minimal user growth
outliers.evidence: Monthly growth only 5% after 8 months; CAC of $2,800 vs $450-650 at similar ventures; team velocity decelerating with 2 open key hires unfilled
outliers.recommended_action: Trigger emergency governance review within 2 weeks - venture at critical risk. Assess whether market is viable or hypothesis was wrong. Runway of 8 months leaves limited time for pivot or orderly wind-down

ventures_with_issues.issue: Health report 3 days old (acceptable), but historical comparison flags show pattern of delayed reporting

next_decision_focus: Emergency review for TruckRoute Pro - kill or pivot?

portfolio_snapshot.analysis_notes: DataFlow and MediLink show clear bifurcation from TruckRoute Pro. The latter's poor unit economics (CAC/LTV 0.778) combined with decelerating growth in week 32 suggests either market problem or GTM problem. Early intervention likely better than continuing to burn capital. All other metrics high quality with 96% data completeness and <3 days staleness overall.
